notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
Game balance was reworked for better perception of game difficulty

Reduced experience reward
Reduced money reward
Enemies became stronger
Armor perk war nerfed


Several UI bugs were fixed

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Added possibility to restart level which is already completed
Fixed dodge cooldown perk
Fixed bosses attack damage
Fixed game freeze in some cases
